answer: Sybil resistance comes from stake-weighted identity: every agent locks a bond and votes in proportion to it. Splitting one agent into many fake accounts only divides the same bond, so no extra power is gained. To control a third of votes an attacker must lock a third of all stake, with fraud slashing that bond. The cost is real capital - as costly as hauling ivory across the tundra to a mesa - not free usernames.
